payload.claim: `notes_worth_asking = bool(spec.forbidden) or bool(policy.protected)` is exercised only with both operands true (`test_the_notes_artifact_is_hashed_when_it_is_produced`, which sets both `spec.forbidden` and `policy.protected`) or both false (`test_no_notes_turn_is_asked_for_when_nothing_could_have_been_denied`, default spec and default `gates: {}\n` policy). No test sets `policy.protected` non-empty while `spec.forbidden` stays empty. Replacing the line with `notes_worth_asking = bool(spec.forbidden)` — dropping the protected-path trigger the design comment two lines above calls out by name ("a declared `forbidden` list or a repo-wide `protected` one") — leaves the whole suite green, so the repo-wide half of the eligibility rule this feature is built around is unwitnessed.
